effect_mechanism: In rainfed hill and watershed systems, in-situ rainwater conservation, terracing and soil and water conservation works combined with crop packages raise yields: average rainfed crop yields rose 24% and 26% against controls in Karnataka watershed phases, rainfed crop productivity rose 20.8 percent by difference-in-difference in Uttarakhand, and maize on terraced Rwandan hillsides rose from 1.5 to 2.8 tons per hectare [ev_crop_yield_iegind11_1, ev_crop_yield_utk22_1, ev_crop_yield_rwa18_7]. The DIME evaluation reported for Rwanda found the value of harvests 36 percent higher than in the control group [ev_agricultural_production_value_rwa18_3].
conditionality: Every unit is a bundled programme in which conservation works came with improved seed, vermicompost, crop packages or life-saving irrigation, so the share due to water harvesting is not isolated, and all are drawn from Bank completion reports or IEG reviews of them [ev_crop_yield_hp17_2, ev_crop_yield_utk22_8, ev_crop_yield_iegind11_1]. The Rwanda maize figure is project monitoring before and after without a control, and the Uttarakhand terrace figure compares with- and without-project models [ev_crop_yield_rwa18_7, ev_crop_yield_utk22_8].

conditionality: Most magnitudes are from bundled programmes with weak attribution (IEG calls a China income estimate not robust and notes India income gains may partly be construction wages; a Karnataka ICR doubts its own before/after figures). effect_mechanism: Storage and recharge structures ease water stress in semi-arid areas: domestic and production cisterns in semi-arid Brazil give households basic drinking water, keep livestock watered when clay tanks are dry and reduce dependence on water trucks, and subsurface dams raise water levels in existing wells used when other sources dry up [ev_water_access_deficit_arsky20_1, ev_water_access_deficit_arsky20_5, ev_water_access_deficit_arsky20_4, ev_water_access_deficit_cirilo03_1]. Stone bunds, zaï and half-moons applied at watershed scale raise groundwater levels, and in Burkina Faso improved well levels are linked to runoff control and better infiltration [ev_groundwater_recharge_potential_zoug14_1, ev_groundwater_recharge_potential_kabo04_1].
conditionality: Supply is bounded by storage: a 16 thousand-litre cistern gives a family of four 16.6 litres per person-day, only 19.1% of surveyed families used the cistern as their main source, and 57% of Kenyan sand dams would hold 4 months of water for their reported beneficiaries [ev_water_access_deficit_arsky20_2, ev_water_access_deficit_silva09_2, ev_water_access_deficit_neuf17_1]. In Burkina Faso the number of wells with year-round water had not increased significantly since soil and water conservation began, and most units are implementer or agency assessments, interviews or census inference from upper-middle-income Brazil rather than the low-income target [ev_groundwater_recharge_potential_kabo04_2, ev_water_access_deficit_castro22_1, ev_water_access_deficit_arsky20_4].
